name: release-1.31.8
body:
[nginx-1.31.8](https://nginx.org/en/download.html) mainline version has been released.

See official [CHANGES](https://nginx.org/en/CHANGES) on nginx.org.

Below is a release summary generated by GitHub.

## What's Changed
* Version bump by @pluknet in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1846
* HTTP/3: avoid undefined behaviour with empty encoder field values by @dgprivate in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1701
* Win32: removed the iocp event module by @VadimZhestikov in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1823
* Control: logged errors from accepted socket setup. by @OskarEichler in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1720
* Dav: restored the request URI on a destination mapping error by @VadimZhestikov in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1778
* SSL: ignored EIO after shutdown with kernel TLS by @VadimZhestikov in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1788
* SSL: workaround for i2d_SSL_SESSION() negative values by @VadimZhestikov in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1599
* Control API: use more portable ioctl(FIOASYNC) by @bavshin-f5 in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1819
* Fixed Priority parsing of large integers on 32-bit platforms by @nishat-06 in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1814
* JSON: parser API refactoring. by @ensh63 in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1806
* Fixed a typo by @osokin in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1857
* GH: workflow to generate windows zip by @saikrishnakumarreddy in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1815
* GH: request an id token and pass secrets to a callee in buildbot.yml by @thresheek in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1804
* Misc: fixed "zip" target with GNU sed by @pluknet in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1859
* HTTP/3: avoid unaligned stores in Huffman encoding by @daewoo1109 in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1317
* working_directory fixes by @pluknet in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1855
* nginx-1.31.8-RELEASE by @pluknet in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1886

## New Contributors
* @dgprivate made their first contribution in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1701
* @OskarEichler made their first contribution in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1720
* @ensh63 made their first contribution in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1806
* @osokin made their first contribution in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1857
* @daewoo1109 made their first contribution in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/1317

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nginx/nginx/compare/release-1.31.7...release-1.31.8
